phase_name: Boundary Violation Return and NO-GO Maintenance Rules Design
phase_japanese_name: 境界違反時の差し戻し・NO_GO維持ルール設計
purpose: Design return routing and NO_GO maintenance rules when boundary violations are detected between implementation-start GO and operation-transition GO

categories.BV1: Implementation-start GO used as operation-transition authorization
categories.BV2: Unauthorized mutation of production_status from implementation layer
categories.BV4: Cross-source consistency mismatch across go_establishment and boundary records
categories.BV5: Signature invalidity or evidence tamper detected in boundary audit trail

rules.rule_BM1: Any BV1-BV5 triggers immediate NO_GO reassertion
rules.rule_BM2: Route remediation to Phase 22-2/22-3/22-4 depending on failure category
rules.rule_BM3: Block operation-transition GO decision while unresolved_violations_count > 0
rules.rule_BM4: Maintain app/tests implementation status as NO_GO until clean re-audit
rules.rule_BM5: Escalate to HALT_REVIEW_REQUIRED when repeated boundary violations exceed threshold
